Messages.Author: Adam J. O'Banion
Messages.Body:
Thought I would share this with anyone who's interested :
If you've already done it, cool, if not try, it's a hoot.

When one of your opponents is playing Malkavians and has a vampire in
torpor, play Malk Dementia on their Justicar, Prince, Primogen and then
diablerize their own minion with it. Then use the extra votes of the
vamp to make sure it goes down too . . . Possibly the rottenest use of
Malk Dementia we've hit yet. It's worth using some extra stealth on
the action just to see your opponents face . . .

taig
